summary: Preserved the approved CAD-001 sheet-metal door and added a separate grounded XG-07A catch component comprising a 20 x 36.5 x 1.5 mm plate and a round-rod U loop with 26 mm projection, mounted on the 25 mm hidden return at the required 5 mm inward edge inset.

checks.sheet_metal_health: PASS — CAD-001 door remains one body with 10 healthy features
checks.interference: NOT_APPLICABLE — CAD-002 is the static catch-only gate; intentional plate/return mounting contact is present
checks.flat_pattern: PASS — approved CAD-001 flat pattern remains present
checks.static_placement: PASS — plate on hidden return, 5 mm inset, 26 mm loop projection

deviations: UCATCH_LOOP_LEG_SPACING is set provisionally to 12 mm because that dimension is not stated in the repository source documents.
questions_for_design_authority: Confirm or correct the provisional 12 mm U-catch loop leg-center spacing against the physical or fully dimensioned XG-07A catch before fabrication use.
